zh.name: 玄爪狼卒
zh.desc: 来自玄爪猎群的步离人士兵，擅长在无声息中猎杀目标。

skill_list.skill_desc: 对指定我方单体目标及其相邻目标造成少量物理属性伤害，若自身处于【<u>月狂</u>】状态，则大概率为目标附上【裂伤】。

220320102.name: 月狂
220320102.desc: 此状态下，玄爪狼卒的速度提高，且攻击时大概率为目标附上【裂伤】，玄爪狼卒被弱点击破时解除此状态。

skill_list.skill_desc: 当敌方施放攻击后，为<u>能够进入【月狂】状态的敌方单位</u>附加1层【<u>嗜血</u>】，当【<u>嗜血</u>】达到指定层数时，将使其进入【<u>月狂</u>】状态。\n行动序列上出现【月狂】倒计时，倒计时回合开始时所有敌方单位解除【<u>月狂</u>】状态。

220320101.name: 能够进入【月狂】状态的敌方单位
220320101.desc: 能够进入【月狂】状态的敌方单位：玄爪狼卒、 蚀月狼卒、咆哮灵柩、咆哮灵柩（错误）、步离战首•呼雷、步离战首•呼雷（完整）。

220320102.name: 月狂
220320102.desc: 此状态下，玄爪狼卒的速度提高，且攻击时大概率为目标附上【裂伤】，玄爪狼卒被弱点击破时解除此状态。

220320103.name: 嗜血
220320103.desc: 所有能够进入【月狂】的敌方单位共享【嗜血】层数。当有能够进入【月狂】的敌方单位进入战斗时，将附加相同层数的【嗜血】。回合结束时，若场上所有能够进入【月狂】的敌方单位均被击败，清除所有【嗜血】层数。

en.name: Sableclaw Wolftrooper
en.desc: A borisin soldier from the Sableclaw Pack. Specializes in assassinating the target in silence.

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals minor Physical DMG to a single target and its adjacent units. If this unit is under the <u>Moon Rage</u> state, there is a high chance to inflict Bleed on the target.

220320102.name: Moon Rage
220320102.desc: In this state, Sableclaw Wolftrooper's SPD increases, and their attacks have a high chance of inflicting "Bleed" on the target. This state will be dispelled when Sableclaw Wolftrooper is Weakness Broken.

skill_list.skill_desc: After a friendly unit launches an attack, applies 1 stack of "<u>Bloodlust</u>" to <u>friendly units who can enter the "Moon Rage" effect</u>. When "<u>Bloodlust</u>" reaches a certain stack, the friendly unit enters the "<u>Moon Rage</u>" state.\nA "Moon Rage" countdown icon appears in the Action Order. When the countdown's turn begins, "<u>Moon Rage</u>" is dispelled across all friendly units.

220320101.name: Enemy units that can enter "Moon Rage"
220320101.desc: Enemy units that can enter "Moon Rage": Sableclaw Wolftrooper, Eclipse Wolftrooper, Howling Casket, Howling Casket (Bug), Borisin Warhead: Hoolay, Borisin Warhead: Hoolay (Complete).

220320102.name: Moon Rage
220320102.desc: In this state, Sableclaw Wolftrooper's SPD increases, and their attacks have a high chance of inflicting "Bleed" on the target. This state will be dispelled when Sableclaw Wolftrooper is Weakness Broken.

220320103.name: Bloodlust
220320103.desc: All enemy units that can enter "Moon Rage" will share "Bloodlust" stacks. When enemy units that can enter "Moon Rage" join the battle, the same number of "Bloodlust" stacks will be applied to them. At the end of the turn, if all enemies that can enter "Moon Rage" have been defeated, clears all "Bloodlust" stacks.
